entry.title: New: Bill 52 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 13.04A, MAUI COUNTY CODE, TO AUTHORIZE A COMMUNITY RECREATIONAL GARDENS PROGRAM" The purpose of this bill is to amend Chapter 13.04A, Maui County Code, by adding a new article, entitled Article IX, Community Recreational Gardens.
